title: Publish
summary: Generate a site and hand it to a host — from the editor.
body:
No site in the folder yet? JustJSON generates a small **Astro site** wired to your content — a home page and a page per entry, nothing you already have overwritten.

From the **Ship it** tab you can commit, push to GitHub, and hand the repo to **Vercel or Netlify**. After that, publishing is one button — they rebuild on every push. Still no account with us; the files stay yours.

The endpoint is yours too: wherever you put the JSON becomes your API — repo raw, jsDelivr, your own build.
